Feature-space scatter layer

geom_features.Rd

Draws each series as a point in a two-dimensional feature space, such as trend strength against seasonal strength. The variables on either axis can be changed interactively to any other numeric column of data.

Usage

geom_features(mapping = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL, elementId = NULL)

Arguments

mapping

Optional layer-level gig_aes() that overrides the plot mapping. x and y give the initial feature columns.

width, height

Optional widget size (any valid CSS unit). When omitted, sizing follows the htmlwidgets and knitr defaults.

elementId

Optional element id.

Value

A gig_layer.

See also

gig()

Examples

library(fabletools)
library(feasts)

tas_tourism <- aus_tourism[aus_tourism$State == "Tasmania", ]
tas_features <- tas_tourism |>
  aggregate_key((State / Region) * Purpose, Trips = sum(Trips)) |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl)

gig(tas_features, gig_aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_year)) +
  geom_features() +
  hierarchy((State / Region) * Purpose)
